text_en: The Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they had come out of the land of Egypt, saying:
text_cn: 以色列人出埃及国后第二年二月一日，上主在西乃旷野于会幕内训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Take a census of the whole congregation of Israelites, in their clans, by ancestral houses, according to the number of names, every male individually;
text_cn: “你们要依照以色列子民的宗族和家系，统计全会众的人口，把男丁的姓名都一一登记。

text_en: from twenty years old and upward, everyone in Israel able to go to war. You and Aaron shall enroll them, company by company.
text_cn: 在以色列中，凡二十岁以上能上阵作战的，你和亚郎要一队一队地统计。

text_en: A man from each tribe shall be with you, each man the head of his ancestral house.
text_cn: 每一支派有一人同你们合作，他们都是各宗族的族长。

text_en: These are the names of the men who shall assist you: From Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur.
text_cn: 那协助你们的人名如下：勒乌本支派，是舍德乌尔的儿子厄里族尔；

text_en: From Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
text_cn: 西默盎支派，是族黎沙待的儿子舍路米耳；

text_en: From Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab.
text_cn: 犹大支派，是阿米纳达布的儿子纳赫雄；

text_en: From Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar.
text_cn: 依撒加尔支派，是族阿尔的儿子乃塔乃耳；

text_en: From Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon.
text_cn: 则步隆支派，是赫隆的儿子厄里雅布；

text_en: From the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud; from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.
text_cn: 若瑟的两个儿子：厄弗辣因支派，是阿米胡得的儿子厄里沙玛；默纳协支派，是培达族尔的儿子加默里耳；

text_en: From Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni.
text_cn: 本雅明支派，是基德敖尼的儿子阿彼丹；

text_en: From Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
text_cn: 丹支派，是阿米沙待的儿子阿希厄则尔；

text_en: From Asher, Pagiel son of Ochran.
text_cn: 阿协尔支派，是敖革兰的儿子帕革厄耳；

text_en: From Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel.
text_cn: 加得支派，是勒乌耳的儿子厄肋雅撒夫；

text_en: From Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan.
text_cn: 纳斐塔里支派，是厄南的儿子阿希辣。”

text_en: These were the ones chosen from the congregation, the leaders of their ancestral tribes, the heads of the divisions of Israel.
text_cn: 这些人是由会众中选出来的，都是他们宗族的领袖，以色列的千夫长。

text_en: Moses and Aaron took these men who had been designated by name,
text_cn: 梅瑟和亚郎就带着这些提名派定的人，

text_en: and on the first day of the second month they assembled the whole congregation together. They registered themselves in their clans, by their ancestral houses, according to the number of names from twenty years old and upward, individually,
text_cn: 于二月一日召集了全会众，人都依照宗族和家系登了记，由二十岁以上的，都一一将姓名登了记。

text_en: as the Lord commanded Moses. So he enrolled them in the wilderness of Sinai.
text_cn: 上主怎样吩咐了梅瑟，梅瑟就怎样在西乃旷野统计了他们。

text_en: The descendants of Reuben, Israel’s firstborn, their lineage, in their clans, by their ancestral houses, according to the number of names, individually, every male from twenty years old and upward, everyone able to go to war:
text_cn: 以色列的长子勒乌本子孙的后裔，依照宗族和家系，二十岁以上，凡能上阵作战的男子，都一一将姓名登了记；

text_en: those enrolled of the tribe of Reuben were forty-six thousand five hundred.
text_cn: 勒乌本支派登记的，计有四万六千五百。

text_en: The descendants of Simeon, their lineage, in their clans, by their ancestral houses, those of them that were numbered, according to the number of names, individually, every male from twenty years old and upward, everyone able to go to war:
text_cn: 西默盎子孙的后裔，依照宗族和家系，二十岁以上，凡能上阵作战的男子，都一一将姓名登了记，

text_en: those enrolled of the tribe of Simeon were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
text_cn: 西默盎支派登记的，计有五万九千三百。

text_en: The descendants of Gad, their lineage, in their clans, by their ancestral houses, according to the number of the names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone able to go to war:
text_cn: 加得子孙的后裔，依照宗族和家系，二十岁以上，凡能上阵作战的，都将姓名登了记；

text_en: those enrolled of the tribe of Gad were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
text_cn: 加得支派登记的，计有四万五千六百五十。

text_en: The descendants of Judah, their lineage, in their clans, by their ancestral houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone able to go to war:
text_cn: 犹大子孙的后裔，依照宗族和家系，二十岁以上，凡能上阵作战的，都将姓名登了记；

text_en: those enrolled of the tribe of Judah were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
text_cn: 犹大支派登记的，计有七万四千六百。

text_en: The descendants of Issachar, their lineage, in their clans, by their ancestral houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone able to go to war:
text_cn: 依撒加尔子孙的后裔，依照宗族和家系，二十岁以上，凡能上阵作战的，都将姓名登了记，

text_en: those enrolled of the tribe of Issachar were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
text_cn: 依撒加尔支派登记的，计有五万四千四百。

text_en: The descendants of Zebulun, their lineage, in their clans, by their ancestral houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone able to go to war:
text_cn: 则步隆子孙的后裔，依照宗族和家系，二十岁以上，凡能上阵作战的，都将姓名登了记；

text_en: those enrolled of the tribe of Zebulun were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
text_cn: 则步隆支派登记的，计有五万七千四百。

text_en: The descendants of Joseph, namely, the descendants of Ephraim, their lineage, in their clans, by their ancestral houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone able to go to war:
text_cn: 若瑟的子孙：厄弗辣因子孙的后裔，依照宗族和家系，二十岁以上，凡能上阵作战的，都将姓名登了记；

text_en: those enrolled of the tribe of Ephraim were forty thousand five hundred.
text_cn: 厄弗辣因支派登记的，计有四万五百。

text_en: The descendants of Manasseh, their lineage, in their clans, by their ancestral houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone able to go to war:
text_cn: 默纳协子孙的后裔，依照宗族和家系，二十岁以上，凡能上阵作战的男子，都一一将姓名登了记；

text_en: those enrolled of the tribe of Manasseh were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
text_cn: 默纳协支派登记的，计有三万二千二百。

text_en: The descendants of Benjamin, their lineage, in their clans, by their ancestral houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone able to go to war:
text_cn: 本雅明子孙的后裔，依照宗族和家系，二十岁以上，凡能上阵作战的，都将姓名登了记；

text_en: those enrolled of the tribe of Benjamin were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
text_cn: 本雅明支派登记的，计有三万五千四百。

text_en: The descendants of Dan, their lineage, in their clans, by their ancestral houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone able to go to war:
text_cn: 丹子孙的后裔，依照宗族和家系，二十岁以上，凡能上阵作战的，都将姓名登了记；

text_en: those enrolled of the tribe of Dan were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
text_cn: 丹支派登记的，计有六万二千七百。

text_en: The descendants of Asher, their lineage, in their clans, by their ancestral houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone able to go to war:
text_cn: 阿协尔子孙的后裔，依照宗族和家系，二十岁以上，凡能上阵作战的，都将姓名登了记；

text_en: those enrolled of the tribe of Asher were forty-one thousand five hundred.
text_cn: 阿协尔支派登记的，计有四万一千五百。

text_en: The descendants of Naphtali, their lineage, in their clans, by their ancestral houses, according to the number of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone able to go to war:
text_cn: 纳斐塔里子孙的后裔，依照宗族和家系，二十岁以上，凡能上阵作战的，都将姓名登了记；

text_en: those enrolled of the tribe of Naphtali were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
text_cn: 纳斐塔里支派登记的，计有五万三千四百：

text_en: These are those who were enrolled, whom Moses and Aaron enrolled with the help of the leaders of Israel, twelve men, each representing his ancestral house.
text_cn: 以上是梅瑟和亚郎并以色列的首领十二人──每宗族一人──所登记的人数。

text_en: So the whole number of the Israelites, by their ancestral houses, from twenty years old and upward, everyone able to go to war in Israel—
text_cn: 以色列中二十岁以上，凡能上阵作战的以色列子民，全依照宗族和家系登了记。

text_en: their whole number was six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
text_cn: 全体登记的总数，是六十万三千五百五十。

text_en: The Levites, however, were not numbered by their ancestral tribe along with them.
text_cn: 但是肋未人没有依照自己的宗派同他们一起登记，

text_en: The Lord had said to Moses:
text_cn: 因为上主曾训示梅瑟说：

text_en: Only the tribe of Levi you shall not enroll, and you shall not take a census of them with the other Israelites.
text_cn: “只有肋未支派，不要登记，不要将他们列在以色列子民内。

text_en: Rather you shall appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the covenant, and over all its equipment, and over all that belongs to it; they are to carry the tabernacle and all its equipment, and they shall tend it, and shall camp around the tabernacle.
text_cn: 你应派肋未人管理会幕和其中一切器皿，并一切附属物。他们要搬运会幕和其中一切器皿，在会幕中服务，住在会幕的四周。

text_en: When the tabernacle is to set out, the Levites shall take it down; and when the tabernacle is to be pitched, the Levites shall set it up. And any outsider who comes near shall be put to death.
text_cn: 会幕要迁移时，肋未人拆卸；会幕要搭扎时，肋未人张搭；若俗人走近，应处死刑。

text_en: The other Israelites shall camp in their respective regimental camps, by companies;
text_cn: 以色列子民应分队扎营，各归本旗。

text_en: but the Levites shall camp around the tabernacle of the covenant, that there may be no wrath on the congregation of the Israelites; and the Levites shall perform the guard duty of the tabernacle of the covenant.
text_cn: 但肋未人应在会幕四周扎营，免得以色列子民会众触犯天怒；肋未人应负责看守会幕。”

text_en: The Israelites did so; they did just as the Lord commanded Moses.
text_cn: 以色列子民都照办了；上主怎样吩咐了梅瑟，他们就怎样办了。
